notes.title: Updates for Frizzy patch v1.3
notes.content:
[h1] TEAM FRIZZ IS LOOKING FOR LET'S PLAYERS! [/h1]

[h1] Patch Notes [/h1]

- Adds a new system to make Balloons (latchable objects) harder to spam.  This system adds an cool down to balloon placement, and an on screen GUI object that display the cool down.  

- Adds a system that sees to help the player orient themselves within the level.  A color coded background will help the user gain perspective within the larger levels.

- Fixes a bug that misaligned the "World Name" in the GUI on the level selection/world scene.

notes.title: Updates for patch v1.2
notes.content:
[h1] Patch Notes [/h1]

- Fixed a bug in boss fights that disabled the Countdown timer.
- Fixed a bug where boss fights would have the loading screen permanently overlayed.
- [b]Added a cut scene inbetween worlds 1 and 2[/b]
- fixed a bug that caused achievements to function improperly

notes.title: Updates, patch notes for Frizzy_v0.8
notes.content:
[h1]10/13/15 - v0.8 bugfixes[/h1]

- Fixed a bug where the cursor could not reach the bottom of the screen
- Fixed a bug where the System cursor displayed as well the in-game cursor
- Fixed a bug where users could not properly navigate the main menu
- Fixed a bug where users were incorrectly notified to "Log in"
- Fixed a bug involving possible deletion of save files
- Fixed a bug that wildly inflated the size of the game download
- removed unnecessary .dll files
- changes to game app icon
- changes to Frizzy's ability to place latch-able balloons
- changes to scroll speed of backstory in intro cut scene
- slight changes to progress screen layout
- Adds an indicator for failed balloon placement (too close to other balloons)
- Adds a functioning "Quit" button (how did I forget this??)
- Adds a visual and audio cue to Cat Coin collection


[h1]Upcoming Patches in future v0.9[/h1]

- Achievements are dysfunctional right now
- New Achievement icons
- New Trading Cards
- New Badges
